item.title: Buddhist monks on final leg of 'Walk for Peace' to DC
item.description: A group of Buddhist monks walking across the country for peace is continuing its trek through Northern Virginia on Friday as they near the final stretch of their 2,300‑mile journey to Washington, D.C.The monks have been on the road for months, drawing large crowds as they make their way through the Commonwealth. item.title: Sonny Jurgensen, Washington football legend and Hall of Fame quarterback, dies at 91

"He was a giant of the game, and a beloved part of our team's identity. item.title: Rock blockage delays sewer line repair after major Potomac spill
item.description: More than two weeks after a collapsed sewer line sent massive amounts of wastewater into the Potomac River, crews hit another setback when a large rock blocking repair work was discovered.Engineers say the obstruction, located nearly 30 feet downstream from the original break, will delay full repairs by an estimated four to six weeks. item.title: Juvenile curfew once again in effect at National Harbor
item.description: A juvenile curfew is once again in place at National Harbor.It’s a renewal of the curfew that was in effect for most of 2025. The curfew is in effect from 5 p.m. to 5 a.m. on Friday and Saturday. Anyone under 18 years old has to be with a parent or guardian, or an authorized adult 21 years old or older.Violations could result in a fine for parents — up to $250.There are a few caveats to the rule.
